# LightGBM (S4): single test evaluation (generated by `scripts/run_lightgbm.py`; part P3 (a) of the completion batch)

Git commit `8071d40621`. Feature set S4 (scenario A), ratio target, same samples as the XGBoost models of each task, 30 random trials per task (2 in a smoke run), early stopping on validation (40 rounds), 3 seeds, mean prediction. MAE in MW. Models fitted on the training period only with the validation-chosen configuration and trees.
